name: progressive-disclosure-planning
description: Plan progressive disclosure for a surface — what to show first, what to hide, what to reveal on demand. Produces layered information architecture (primary / secondary / on-demand / power-user), user-type differentiation (novice / intermediate / expert), reveal triggers (action / state / time / tenure), and discoverability mechanisms. Covers Norman / Nielsen heuristics and platform conventions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
